The tickets are ordered so that each one leaves the console working and committed: T21, then T22, then T23, then T24.\n\n## Tickets\n\n- #26 T21: Console shell\n- #27 T22: Lists and create pages\n- #28 T23: Edit pages\n- #29 T24: Dashboard","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"d729b860-84ed-47ba-a463-ca44008b1bd9","timestamp":"2026-10-01T19:49:04.392Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"## main...origin/main [ahead 6]\n M notes/usage-ledger.csv\n?? docs/transcripts/iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_22_davelle-ampofo-twumasi_20261001.md\nT21: close the Console shell ticket\n\nThe bar's nav numbers and its \"Institutional Research\" label are back to\nthe approved mockup's bright purple: 5.35:1 light and 4.62:1 dark on the\nfield, so it passes. The screenshots are retaken with it, and with the\nbar's new breakpoints.\n\nCode review findings and how each was resolved, the browser check, and\nthe contrast table are on the issue.\n\nCloses #26\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\n\ntitle:\tT22: Lists and create pages\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tDavelleAT (Davelle Ampofo-Twumasi)\nlabels:\tticket\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t27\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of #25\n\n## What to build\n\nThe Data Bites, Reports, and All content lists as tables, with filters. Creating an item moves to its own page.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] `/admin/data-bites` and `/admin/reports` are `table-items` tables:\n  - Columns: title with its Summary under it, a state badge (Published or Draft), author, Updated (ISO, mono), and row actions. The actions are Edit, Publish/Unpublish (where the user may), and Delete (Director)\n  - Each action is a POST with CSRF, as now\n- [ ] Filters: All / Published / Drafts, each with its count, via `?status=`. An unknown value is a 400\n- [ ] \"New Data Bite\" / \"New Report\" in the page head opens `/admin/data-bites/new` / `/admin/reports/new`, which render the create form (Title, Summary, address, Editor, Site preview, and a Report's PDF). The POST targets stay `/admin/data-bites` and `/admin/reports`\n- [ ] The list pages no longer contain the create form\n- [ ] After a create, the redirect goes to the new item's edit page. A refused create re-renders the `/new` page with the error by its field\n- [ ] The All content page uses the same table\n- [ ] Rows stack on a phone, and the table keeps its semantics\n- [ ] Tests:\n  - Each filter shows only its state, and a bad `?status=` is a 400\n  - The `/new` pages render the form, and a create redirects to the edit page\n  - Tests asserting the old create redirect or list markup are updated, with the reason in the commit\n  - The whole suite passes\n- [ ] Browser check in the closing comment, with screenshots: both lists and a create, at 390, 768, and 1440 px, in light and dark\n\n## Blocked by\n\n- #26 (T21)\n\n----\ntitle:\tSpec: Admin console design — same family, calmer; navigation, lists, edit page, dashboard\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tDavelleAT (Davelle Ampofo-Twumasi)\nlabels:\tspec\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t25\n--\n## Problem Statement\n\nThe public site was redesigned in T19 and T20, but the admin console the Director and Analysts use every day still has no design: the system font, browser-grey buttons, monospace text boxes, and one 42rem column. It is also hard to use:\n\n- **No navigation.** The only way between pages is an \"All Data Bites\" or \"Admin console\" back-link, and Log out is a button that only exists on the admin home.\n- **Crowded list pages.** The Data Bites and Reports list pages also hold the whole create form, the Editor, and a Site preview, so the list sits on top of a long form.\n- **A dashboard that doesn't help.** It is a table of counts, and nothing says what needs attention, such as a draft Report only the Director can publish.\n- **A cramped edit page.** The fields, Editor, and Site preview stack in one column, and Save sits under a long body.\n\nGoal: a console that is as considered as the public site and pleasant to use for hours, which shows each person what needs their attention first.\n\n## Solution\n\nA visual design, **\"same family, calmer\"**, approved from a mockup in session 25. The mockup and its screenshots are in `docs/design/admin-console-mockup/`.\n\n- **Type and colour:** the public site's Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Mono, and its tokens, on light paper throughout. The deep purple field appears only as a slim top bar with its faint grid. Citron appears only in that bar, as the IR mark and the current-page underline. A full dark mode.\n- **Structure:** numbered nav, numbered sections, ISO dates in mono, square status badges, hairline tables, and square buttons with one solid action per view.\n\nAnd four usability changes:\n\n- **Navigation on every page:** 01 Dashboard, 02 Data Bites, 03 Reports, and, for the Director, 04 Homepage and 05 Users. Plus who is signed in, \"View site ↗\", and Log out.\n- **Lists apart from forms:** each list is a table with Summaries, status badges, filters, and row actions. Creating an item opens its own page.\n- **A dashboard of what needs attention:** counts, \"Waiting for you\", and \"Recently changed\".\n- **An edit page laid out for work:** the fields and Editor beside a sticky Site preview, and a save bar pinned to the bottom.\n\n## User Stories\n\n1. As the Director, I want to see, on signing in, which draft Reports are waiting for me to publish, so that nothing sits unreviewed.\n2. As an Analyst, I want to see my own drafts first on the dashboard, so that I pick up where I left off, or where the last shift left off.\n3. As any user, I want the same navigation on every console page, so that I never hunt for a back-link.\n4. As any user, I want to log out from any page.\n5. As any user, I want each list to show every item's Summary, state, author, and last update, and to filter by state, so that I find an item without opening it.\n6. As any user, I want \"New Data Bite\" to open its own page, so that the list stays a list.\n7. As any user, I want the Site preview beside the fields while I edit, and Save always in reach, so that I don't scroll past a long body to save.\n8. As any user, I want to know when I have unsaved changes before I leave.\n9. As any user, I want an item's address shown as `data-bites/<slug>.html`, so that the slug is understandable.\n10. As any user on a laptop at night, I want the console to follow dark mode.\n11. As a keyboard or screen-reader user, I want a skip link, a visible focus ring, labelled fields, and AA contrast in the console too.\n12. As the Director, I want the Users and Homepage pages to look and work like the rest of the console.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n### Shared (ADR-007 stays: two stylesheets, no rule crosses)\n\n- **`static/admin.css` is rewritten** as the console's own stylesheet. It copies the public tokens and the `@font-face` rules, and never links or imports `site.css`. No public rule may reach an admin page, and no admin rule may reach the public site (the T19 tests stay).\n- **Fonts:** `admin.css` is served at `/admin.css`, so its `url(\"fonts/…\")` resolves to `/fonts/…`, which the public route already serves. No new route and no new dependency.\n- **Class names** keep the repo's prefix rule: `.bar-console`, `.nav-console`, `.badge-state-draft`, `.table-items`, `.bar-save`. No bare `.title` or `.status`.\n- **The Editor and the Chart builder are restyled by class only.** `static/editor.js` keeps its markup, classes, and behaviour. In the console, Chart cards use the public site's purples and greys instead of today's blue and orange.\n- **No new database columns.** \"Waiting for you\" is derived from what is stored: a draft Report is waiting for the Director, and an Analyst's own drafts are theirs.\n- **Accessibility:** skip link, `:focus-visible` ring, labelled fields, and text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in both themes, recorded in each closing comment.\n\n### T21: Console shell\n\n- `base.html` becomes the console layout:\n  - The slim bar with the IR mark and \"Console\".\n  - Numbered nav. Homepage and Users show only for a Director. `aria-current` marks the current section.\n  - The signed-in user's name and role, \"View site ↗\" to the public home, and Log out (a POST with CSRF) on every signed-in page.\n  - A skip link and the Confirmation, restyled.\n- On a phone, the nav scrolls sideways under the bar and never wraps, as on the public site.\n- The login, \"Not allowed\" (403), confirm-delete, Users, and Homepage settings pages move to the new look and type. They keep their behaviour.\n- Dark mode via `prefers-color-scheme`.\n\n### T22: Lists and create pages\n\n- `/admin/data-bites` and `/admin/reports` become `table-items` tables:\n  - Columns: title with its Summary under it, a state badge, author, Updated (ISO), and row actions (Edit, Publish/Unpublish, and Delete for a Director). Each action is a POST with CSRF, as now.\n  - Filters: All / Published / Drafts, each with its count, via `?status=`. An unknown value is a 400, as on the All content page.\n  - A \"New Data Bite\" or \"New Report\" button in the page head.\n- The create forms move to `/admin/data-bites/new` and `/admin/reports/new`, laid out like the edit page. The POST target stays `/admin/data-bites` and `/admin/reports`.\n- **After a create, the redirect goes to the new item's edit page**, not the list. Tests that assert the old location are updated in the same commit, with the reason.\n- The All content page uses the same table.\n- Rows stack on a phone. The table keeps its semantics, as in T20's Reports table.\n\n### T23: Edit pages\n\n- Two columns at desktop width, one below 64rem:\n  - Left: Title (large), Summary with its count, the slug as an address field (`data-bites/` [slug] `.html`), and the Editor.\n  - Right: the Site preview with Desktop / Phone and \"Open ↗\", sticky.\n- **A save bar pinned to the bottom** shows the state badge, an \"Unsaved changes\" marker, Save, and Publish/Unpublish and Delete where the user may do them. Buttons outside the item's form use the `form=` attribute or their own small forms. No action may lose CSRF or the stale-form check (`item_base`).\n- The \"Unsaved changes\" marker follows the Editor's existing dirty state (`body_dirty`) and any field's `input` event.\n- A Report's PDF field and its chart images sit under the Editor.\n- A Report that is locked for an Analyst keeps today's read-only view, in the new layout.\n\n### T24: Dashboard\n\n- Head: \"Dashboard\", today's date, the user's role, and \"New Data Bite\" (plus \"New Report\").\n- Four counts (Data Bites published and drafts, Reports published and drafts), each linking to its filtered list.\n- **01 Waiting for you:**\n  - For a Director: draft Reports, oldest update first, each with \"Review\".\n  - For an Analyst: their own drafts, Data Bites and Reports.\n  - Empty, it says so.\n- **02 Recently changed:** the 8 most recently updated items of both kinds, with a state badge and an ISO date, and a link to All content.\n- **Side panels:** \"The public site\" (publishing reaches it at the next `cms publish`, plus \"View the site ↗\"), and, for a Director, \"Homepage\" (when it was last saved, plus \"Edit homepage\").\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\n- Existing tests keep passing. A test that asserts on today's console markup or a redirect location is updated in the same commit, with the reason.\n- New tests:\n  - Every signed-in console page has the nav and a Log out form with a CSRF token.\n  - An Analyst's nav has no Homepage or Users link.\n  - No admin page links `style.css`; no public page links `admin.css` (kept from T19).\n  - Each list's filter shows only that state, and a bad `?status=` is a 400.\n  - `/admin/data-bites/new` and `/admin/reports/new` render the form, and a create redirects to the new item's edit page.\n  - The edit page's save-bar buttons each post with a CSRF token. A stale form is still refused (409).\n  - \"Waiting for you\": a Director sees draft Reports and not published ones. An Analyst sees their own drafts and not another Analyst's. Nothing from it leaks to a public page.\n- **Browser check** in each closing comment, at 390, 768, and 1440 px in light and dark, with screenshots and `document.fonts`. That covers the nav, a list, a create, an edit with the save bar and the unsaved marker, the dashboard as the Director and as an Analyst, and the Users and Homepage pages.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\n- Any change to the public site.\n- New roles, a review or approval workflow, or a \"submit for review\" state. \"Waiting for you\" is derived from existing states.\n- Recording when `cms publish` last ran.\n- Search in the console.\n- Changes to the Editor's behaviour or the Chart builder's features. They are restyled only.\n\n## Further Notes\n\n- Mockup: `docs/design/admin-console-mockup/` (`index.html`, `data-bites.html`, `edit.html`, `console.css`, and `screenshots/`). Its CSS is the starting point for `static/admin.css`.\n- Stage 2 is due Tue Oct 6, 2:40 pm Eastern. The tickets are ordered so that each one leaves the console working and committed: T21, then T22, then T23, then T24.\n\n## Tickets\n\n- #26 T21: Console shell\n- #27 T22: Lists and create pages\n- #28 T23: Edit pages\n- #29 T24: Dashboard","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"af38e14a-06dc-4e61-a578-fb357d07d25f","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":5},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"be2a3aa6-bdb5-46e5-aee7-b22593d5f478","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"6533e42d-acc5-4443-89bb-f376b37640bf","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"c3b6407f-f3ff-4448-adcd-10882366d57b","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"eb019712-94ba-463b-8cf2-b3c8e4254f55","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013cghjTfWf5sqcoJbCVpmf6","type":"tool_result","content":"# Kenyon Office of Institutional Research (IR) CMS\n\nA CMS for Kenyon College's Office of Institutional Research: a two-person office\n(Director + Analyst/intern staff) that publishes survey results, data briefs,\nand durable reference documents like the Factbook and Common Data Set.\n\n## Language\n\n**Director**:\nThe admin role. Modeled on the real office's Associate VP for Institutional\nResearch — the only person who can publish or edit a Report, manage user\naccounts, and deactivate access.\n_Avoid_: Admin, superuser\n\n**Analyst**:\nThe editor role. Each intern gets their own named Analyst account (see\nADR-003). Can draft and publish Data Bites directly; can draft but not\npublish or edit Reports. Any Analyst may edit any other Analyst's draft\n(shift continuity), though the original author is preserved.\n_Avoid_: Editor, intern (interns are Analysts, not a separate role), staff\n\n**Data Bite**:\nA Post: a short, dated item — a survey result, an enrollment snapshot, an\nannouncement. The frequent, low-stakes content type. Analysts can publish\nthese without Director approval.\n_Avoid_: Update, post, announcement, article\n\n**Report**:\nA Page: a durable, cite-able reference document — the Factbook, a Common Data\nSet, the Survey Coordination Policy. Appears in public navigation. Only the\nDirector can publish or edit a Report, even one an Analyst drafted.\n_Avoid_: Page, document\n\n**Draft**:\nContent (a Data Bite or Report) that has been saved but not published. Never\nappears on the public site. Used for unreleased data, e.g. enrollment numbers\nstill being verified before the official count.\n_Avoid_: Unpublished, pending\n\n**Published**:\nContent visible on the public site. The one-way gate: a Report only crosses\nit with Director action.\n_Avoid_: Live, public\n\n**Chart image**:\nAn *uploaded* PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a chart made in Excel, R,\nor Tableau) that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its body with\nthe Editor's \"Insert image\", with a required description, and stored there as\n`image:<name>` (T18). It belongs to its item and is published with\nit (ADR-004). Not a **Chart**, which the CMS draws from data, and not a\nReport's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment\n\n**Chart**:\nA bar, horizontal bar, or line chart the CMS *draws* from data typed or\npasted into it, shown inline in a Data Bite or Report body with its data\navailable as a table (spec #14,\n[ADR-006](docs/adr/ADR-006-charts-drawn-from-data.md)). Stored in the body\nas a `chart` block the writer never sees. Not a **Chart image**, which is made elsewhere and uploaded.\n_Avoid_: graph, plot, visualization\n\n**Chart builder**:\nThe Editor's \"Insert chart\" dialog: a Chart's fields and a grid (categories\ndown, series across) that takes typing or a paste from Excel or Sheets, with\nthe Chart drawn by the server as the writer types and each error beside its\nfield or cell (spec #14, T17). In the body, a Chart shows as a *card*, its\ndrawing with Edit and Remove.\n_Avoid_: chart editor, chart wizard\n\n**Editor**:\nThe visual body editor on a Data Bite's or Report's edit page: a toolbar,\ntables edited in place, Charts, and Chart images, with no Markdown in sight.\nThe body is still stored as Markdown (spec #14,\n[ADR-005](docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md)). A part of a body it\ncan't represent is a **locked block**: shown read-only, kept byte for byte.\n_Avoid_: WYSIWYG, rich text, rich-text editor\n\n**Site link**:\nA link in a Data Bite's or Report's body to another Data Bite or Report,\npicked from a list in the Editor and stored by the target's immutable\nreference, its *site reference* (`report:<ref>`, `data-bite:<ref>`), never\nits title, slug, or id.\nIt is a link on the site only while its target is Published; otherwise it\nshows as plain text (spec #14, T14).\n_Avoid_: internal link, cross-reference\n\n**Site preview**:\nA Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the\nsite's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves\nnothing and publishes nothing.\n_Avoid_: live view\n\n**Summary**:\nOne or two sentences of plain text about a Data Bite or Report, at most 200\ncharacters, written under its title on the edit form. Shown under the title\non its page, in the lists and the Reports table, and in its page's\ndescription and link-preview tags (spec #22, T20). Optional: an item without\none shows nothing in its place.\n_Avoid_: excerpt, abstract, description, blurb\n\n**Homepage settings**:\nThe homepage's headline, its accent (the end of the headline, in bright\npurple), its intro, and its Key figures. Edited by the Director only, at\n/admin/homepage. Settings, not content: no Draft, and on the public site from\nthe next `cms publish`, like a change to the nav (spec #22, T20).\n_Avoid_: hero, homepage content\n\n**Key figure**:\nOne of up to four numbers on the homepage, each a value, a label saying what\nit counts, and an optional note saying when or of whom (e.g. \"1,805\" /\n\"Students enrolled\" / \"Fall 2026 census\"). Typed text, not drawn from data.\n_Avoid_: stat, KPI, metric\n\n**Site search**:\nThe public site's search of published titles and Summaries, entirely static:\n`cms publish` writes `search-index.json` and `search.html`, and\n`search.js` searches the index in the browser. Without JavaScript,\n`search.html` lists every published item. Bodies are not searched (spec #22,\nT20).\n_Avoid_: search engine, full-text search\n\n**Confirmation**:\nThe one-line message the admin console shows, once, after a save, publish,\nupload, delete, or user change succeeds (`app/flash.py`). Fixed text only:\nnever a title, email, filename, or password. A refused action gets an error,\nnot a Confirmation.\n_Avoid_: flash, toast, notification, success message\n\n**Console**:\nThe admin console: the local, signed-in app where the Director and Analysts\nwrite and publish content, never on the public internet. Every page has the\nsame bar: numbered nav (01 Dashboard, 02 Data Bites, 03 Reports, and, for\nthe Director, 04 Homepage and 05 Users), who is signed in, \"View site ↗\",\nand Log out (spec #25, T21). Its home page is the **Dashboard**.\n_Avoid_: back end, dashboard (that is its home page only)\n\n**Factbook**:\nA specific Report: the office's running reference document of admissions,\nenrollment, diversity, and academic program statistics.\n\n**Common Data Set (CDS)**:\nA specific Report: a standardized annual institutional data submission,\npublished publicly.\n\n**Survey Calendar**:\nA specific Report: the schedule of past, current, and upcoming surveys the\noffice runs (e.g. faculty/staff surveys, external review surveys).\nstatic:\nadmin.css\neditor.js\nfonts\nsearch.js\nsite.css\n\nstatic/fonts:\natkinson-hyperlegible-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2\natkinson-hyperlegible-next-latin-wght-italic.woff2\natkinson-hyperlegible-next-latin-wght-normal.woff2\nOFL-atkinson-hyperlegible-mono.txt\nOFL-atkinson-hyperlegible-next.txt\n\ntemplates:\nadmin\nbase.html\nlogin.html\npublic\n\ntemplates/admin:\n_chart_images.html\n_content_fields.html\n_site_preview.html\n_undescribed_images.html\nconfirm_delete.html\ncontent.html\ndata_bite_edit.html\ndata_bites.html\nforbidden.html\nhome.html\nhomepage.html\nreport_edit.html\nreports.html\nusers.html\n\ntemplates/public:\n_lists.html\ndata_bite.html\ndata_bites.html\nhome.html\nlayout.html\nnot_found.html\nreport.html\nreports.html\nsearch.html\n\ntests:\n__pycache__\nconftest.py\ntest_admin_links.py\ntest_admin_pages.py\ntest_ctx_guard.py\ntest_seed_demo.py\ntest_success_messages.py\ntest_t00.py\ntest_t01_auth.py\ntest_t02_users.py\ntest_t03_data_bites.py\ntest_t04_reports.py\ntest_t05_report_files.py\ntest_t06_admin_console.py\ntest_t07_public_site.py\ntest_t08_publish.py\ntest_t09_tables.py\ntest_t10_chart_images.py\ntest_t11_report_chart_images.py\ntest_t12_site_preview.py\ntest_t13_editor_routes.py\ntest_t13_editor.py\ntest_t13_markdown_form.py\ntest_t14_editor_links.py\ntest_t14_links.py\ntest_t14_refs.py\ntest_t15_tables.py\ntest_t16_chart_rendering.py\ntest_t16_chart_saves.py\ntest_t16_charts.py\ntest_t17_chart_cards.py\ntest_t17_chart_fields.py\napp\nCLAUDE.md\ncms.db\nCONTEXT.md\ndocs\nnotes\npyproject.toml\nREADME.md\nscripts\nSECURITY-CHECKLIST.md\nsite\nstatic\ntemplates\ntests\nuploads\nuv.lock\n[project]\nname = \"iphs400-mp2-cms\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\ndescription = \"IPHS 400 MP2 — a small web CMS with a local admin console and a static public site\"\nrequires-python = \">=3.12\"\ndependencies = [\n    \"fastapi>=0.115\",\n    \"uvicorn[standard]>=0.32\",\n    \"jinja2>=3.1\",\n    \"python-multipart>=0.0.12\",   # form posts\n    \"itsdangerous>=2.2\",          # signed session cookies\n    \"argon2-cffi>=23.1\",          # password hashing (never store plain passwords)\n    \"markdown-it-py>=3.0\",        # Markdown -> HTML\n    \"nh3>=0.2\",                   # HTML sanitizer (strips Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import charts, db, site_links\nfrom app.rendering import parse\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show. `field` names the\n    form field it is about, to be shown beside, if it is about one.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str, field: str | None = None):\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.field = field\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\nSTALE = \"This item changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.\"\n\n\nclass StaleItem(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"Saved from an edit form opened on an older version of the item.\"\"\"\n\n\n# A Summary's limit, in characters (code points), which the edit form counts\n# the same way (spec #22).\nSUMMARY_MAX = 200\n\n\ndef item_base(title: str, slug: str, body: str, summary: str = \"\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"The version of an item an edit form was opened on: a hash of its\n    stored title, slug, body, and Summary, all of which the form saves. A\n    hash of the body alone would let a stale form overwrite a newer title or\n    slug.\"\"\"\n    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([title, slug, body, summary]).encode()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef one_line(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Plain text as a Summary or a Homepage setting is stored: its runs of\n    whitespace, line breaks too, as single spaces, trimmed.\"\"\"\n    return \" \".join(text.split())\n\n\ndef validate_summary(summary: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A Summary as stored: plain text on one line, its runs of whitespace\n    (line breaks too) as single spaces, trimmed. Empty is allowed: it's\n    optional. ContentError, about the summary field, if it is too long.\"\"\"\n    summary = one_line(summary)\n    if len(summary) > SUMMARY_MAX:\n        raise ContentError(f\"Keep the summary to {SUMMARY_MAX} characters or fewer; \"\n                           f\"it has {len(summary)}.\", field=\"summary\")\n    return summary\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page;  {\"title\": \"Dashboard\", \"user\": user,\n         \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES, \"counts\": counts,\n         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/content\")\ndef content_list(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user),\n                 content_type: TypeFilter = Query(\"\", alias=\"type\"),\n                 status: StatusFilter = \"\"):\n    \"\"\"Data Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.auth import LoginRequired, current_user\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth, charts, data_bites, homepage, public, reports, users\n\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 8 * 60 * 60  # one working day\nALL_METHODS = [\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\", \"OPTIONS\"]\n\n\n@asynccontextmanager\nasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n    # At server start, not import, so importing app.main never touches a database.\n    db.init_db()\n    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER:\n        print(\"WARNING: CMS_SECRET_KEY is unset or the .env.example placeholder; \"\n              \"session cookies can be forged. Set a long random value in .env.\",\n              file=sys.stderr)\n    yield\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", lifespan=lifespan)\n    app.add_middleware(\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n        session_cookie=\"cms_session\", max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\",\n    )\n\n    app.add_exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException, admin.refused_page)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def redirect_to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    app.include_router(public.router)\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n    app.include_router(data_bites.router)\n    app.include_router(reports.router)\n    app.include_router(charts.router)\n    app.include_router(homepage.router)\n\n    # Must stay last: any /admin request no router above claimed, by path or by\n    # method. Anonymous visitors are sent to login (so they can't probe which\n    # admin paths exist); signed-in users get 405/404.\n    @app.api_route(\"/admin\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    def admin_method_not_allowed():\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=405)\n\n    @app.api_route(\"/admin/{rest:path}\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    def admin_not_found(rest: str):\n        if rest == \"\":\n            return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=307)\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\ntests/test_t06_admin_console.py:125:    assert Editing a published Report, its file, or its\nimages, and publishing, unpublishing, or deleting any Report, is Director\nonly.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse, site_file\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/reports\", dependencies=[Depends(current_user)])\n_MAX_FILE_MB = uploads.MAX_BYTES // uploads.MIB\n_MAX_IMAGE_MB = chart_images.MAX_BYTES // chart_images.MIB\n\n\ndef _site_preview(request: Request, form: Mapping[str, str], report: sqlite3.Row | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to `report` (None for a new\n    Report), as HTML, served from the preview's copy of the site.\"\"\"\n    at = (request.app.url_path_for(\"report_preview_site\", report_id=report[\"id\"], path=\"\")\n          if report is not None else request.app.url_path_for(\"new_report_preview_site\", path=\"\"))\n    return public_site.report_preview(form, report).render_preview(str(at))\n\n\ndef _images(request: Request, report_id: int) -> editor.ImageLinks:\n    return editing.image_links(request, \"serve_image\", report_id=report_id)\n\n\ndef _list_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, *, error: ContentError | None = None,\n               form: dict | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    form = form or {\"title\": \"\", \"slug\": \"\", \"summary\": \"\", \"body\": \"\"}\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], \"\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/reports.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Reports\", \"user\": user,\n         \"reports\": reports.list_all(), \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n         **editing.error_for(error), \"form\": form, \"max_file_mb\": _MAX_FILE_MB,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], \"\", None),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, None),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_new_report\")},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_reports(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _list_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef create_report(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                  slug: str = Form(\"\"), summary: str = Form(\"\"),\n                  posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted),\n                  file: UploadFile | None = File(None)):\n    try:\n        pdf = uploads.read_pdf(file)\n        reports.create(title, slug, editor.saved_body(posted, None, None), user[\"id\"],\n                       summary=summary, pdf=pdf)\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        return _list_page(request, user, error=exc, status_code=400,\n                          form=editor.form_after(posted, title, slug, \"\", None, None,\n                                                 summary=summary))\n    confirm(request, \"Report created as a Draft, with its attached file.\" if pdf\n            else \"Report created as a Draft.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/reports\", status_code=303)\n\n\n# A new Report's Site preview. Before the /{report_id} routes, which would\n# otherwise take \"preview\" for an id.\n\n@router.post(\"/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef preview_new_report(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), summary: str = Form(\"\"),\n                       posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview, for its frame and \"Preview on site\".\n    Saves nothing; a file chosen in the form is not read.\"\"\"\n    shown = editing.previewed(posted, None, None)\n    return HTMLResponse(_site_preview(\n        request, {\"title\": title, \"summary\": summary, \"body\": shown}, None))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/preview/{path:path}\")\ndef new_report_preview_site(path: str):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview's copy of the site: only its stylesheet,\n    as a new Report has no chart images or file (app.routes.site_preview).\"\"\"\n    return site_file(path, images={})\n\n\ndef _edit_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, report: sqlite3.Row, *,\n               error: ContentError | None = None, form: dict | None = None,\n               status_code: int = 200):\n    form = form or editor.form_for(report)\n    # The body with its locked blocks, which only the server sees.\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], report[\"body\"])\n    links, names = _images(request, report[\"id\"]), list(reports.images(report[\"id\"]))\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/report_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Edit Report\", \"user\": user,\n         \"report\": report, \"can_edit\": reports.can_edit(report, user),\n         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS, **editing.error_for(error), \"form\": form,\n         \"max_file_mb\": _MAX_FILE_MB,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], report[\"body\"], links.src),\n         \"images\": names,\n         \"body_images\": editing.body_images(links, names),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, report),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_report\", report_id=report[\"id\"]),\n         \"undescribed_images\": images_without_description(body),\n         \"max_image_mb\": _MAX_IMAGE_MB,\n         \"max_images\": chart_images.MAX_PER_ITEM},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\ndef _get_or_404(report_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    report = reports.get(report_id)\n    if report is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return report\n\n\ndef _editable_or_403(report_id: int, user: sqlite3.Row) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"The Report, if `user` may change it. Checked before anything sent is\n    looked at, so a locked Report is 403 whatever was sent. The write checks\n    again, in its UPDATE, in case the Report is published in between; that\n    raises ReportLocked, which the routes also turn into a 403.\"\"\"\n    report = _get_or_404(report_id)\n    if not reports.can_edit(report, user):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=reports.LOCKED)\n    return report\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}\")\ndef edit_report_form(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _edit_page(request, user, _get_or_404(report_id))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef edit_report(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n                title: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"), summary: str = Form(\"\"),\n                posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted),\n                item_base: str = Form(\"\"), file: UploadFile | None = File(None)):\n    report = _editable_or_403(report_id, user)\n    image_name = _images(request, report_id).name\n    try:\n        pdf = uploads.read_pdf(file)\n        if not reports.update(report_id, title, slug,\n                              editor.saved_edit(posted, report, item_base, image_name),\n                              user=user, summary=summary, pdf=pdf,\n                              base=item_base or None):\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    except reports.ReportLocked as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc)) from None\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        # Shown over the Report as stored now, which a stale form missed.\n        current = _get_or_404(report_id)\n        return _edit_page(request, user, current, error=exc,\n                          status_code=editing.refused_status(exc),\n                          form=editor.form_after(posted, title, slug, item_base,\n                                                 current[\"body\"], image_name,\n                                                 summary=summary))\n    confirm(request, \"Report saved, with its new attached file.\" if pdf\n            else \"Report saved.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/reports/{report_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}/file\")\ndef download_file(report_id: int):\n    report = _get_or_404(report_id)\n    path = reports.file_path(report_id)\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None or not path.is_file():\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return FileResponse(path, media_type=\"application/pdf\",\n                        filename=report[\"file_name\"],\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/file/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef remove_file(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    try:\n        if not reports.remove_file(report_id, user=user):\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    except reports.ReportLocked as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc)) from None\n    confirm(request, \"Attached file removed.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/reports/{report_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef preview_report(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n                   title: str = Form(\"\"), summary: str = Form(\"\"),\n                   posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    \"\"\"The edit form's Site preview, of its unsaved title and body, for its\n    frame and \"Preview on site\". Only for a user who may make those edits\n    (the lockdown). Saves nothing; a file chosen in the form is not read.\"\"\"\n    report = _editable_or_403(report_id, user)\n    shown = editing.previewed(posted, report[\"body\"],\n                      _images(request, report_id).name)\n    return HTMLResponse(_site_preview(\n        request, {\"title\": title, \"summary\": summary, \"body\": shown}, report))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}/preview/{path:path}\")\ndef report_preview_site(request: Request, report_id: int, path: str):\n    \"\"\"The Site preview's copy of the site: its stylesheet and the Report's\n    chart images and file, draft or not, which any signed-in user may already\n    download here (app.routes.site_preview). Its own page, which a draft's\n    Site preview links from the nav, is its Site preview as saved.\"\"\"\n    report = _get_or_404(report_id)\n    if path == public_site.report_path(report[\"slug\"]):\n        return HTMLResponse(_site_preview(request, report, report))\n    return site_file(path, images=public_site.report_image_files(report),\n                     pdfs=public_site.report_pdf_file(report))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}/images/{name}\")\ndef serve_image(report_id: int, name: str):\n    path = reports.images(report_id).get(name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/images\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef upload_image(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n                 file: UploadFile | None = File(None)):\n    report = _editable_or_403(report_id, user)\n    try:\n        if not reports.add_image(report_id, chart_images.read(file), user=user):\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    except reports.ReportLocked as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc)) from None\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        return _edit_page(request, user, report, error=exc, status_code=400)\n    confirm(request, \"Chart image uploaded.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/reports/{report_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/images/{name}/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef delete_image(request: Request, report_id: int, name: str,\n                 user=Depends(current_user)):\n    _editable_or_403(report_id, user)\n    try:\n        if not reports.remove_image(report_id, name, user=user):\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    except reports.ReportLocked as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc)) from None\n    confirm(request, \"Chart image deleted.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/reports/{report_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\ndef _set_status(request: Request, RedirectResponse(\"/admin/reports\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/publish\",\n             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef publish(request: Request, report_id: int):\n    return _set_status(request, report_id, \"published\", \"Report published.\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/unpublish\",\n             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef unpublish(request: Request, report_id: int):\n    return _set_status(request, report_id, \"draft\", \"Report moved back to back=request.app.url_path_for(\"list_reports\"))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/delete\",\n             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef delete(request: Request, {"parentUuid":"e31a8479-9c80-4fab-9a75-f61b1eb4befa","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"eb019712-94ba-463b-8cf2-b3c8e4254f55","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01RtHcwmFoTc1fpYEkmbTuhF","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"T03: Data Bites (issue #4).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom tests.conftest import backdate, post_form, second_analyst\n\nBITE = {\"title\": \"Fall enrollment snapshot\", \"slug\": \"fall-enrollment\",\n        \"body\": \"Enrollment is **1,745** this fall.\"}\n\n\ndef bite_row(c: TestClient, slug: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"This Data Bite's row of the admin list, as HTML.\"\"\"\n    for row in c.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text.split(\"<tr\")[1:]:\n        if f\"<code>{slug}</code>\" in row:\n            return row\n    raise AssertionError(f\"{slug} is not listed\")\n\n\ndef bite_id(c: TestClient, slug: str) -> str:\n    return re.match(r' id=\"data-bite-(\\d+)\"', bite_row(c, slug)).group(1)\n\n\ndef create_bite(c: TestClient, **override) -> str:\n    response = post_form(c, \"/admin/data-bites\", {**BITE, **override})\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return bite_id(c, override.get(\"slug\", BITE[\"slug\"]))\n\n\ndef test_analyst_creates_a_data_bite_as_a_draft(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_form(analyst, \"/admin/data-bites\", BITE)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/data-bites\"\n\n    row = bite_row(analyst, BITE[\"slug\"])\n    assert BITE[\"title\"] in row and \"Draft\" in row\n\n\ndef test_analyst_publishes_and_unpublishes_a_data_bite(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create_bite(analyst)\n\n    response = post_form(analyst, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/publish\", {})\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"Published\" in bite_row(analyst, BITE[\"slug\"])\n\n    response = post_form(analyst, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/unpublish\", {})\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"Draft\" in bite_row(analyst, BITE[\"slug\"])\n\n\ndef test_analyst_cannot_delete_a_data_bite(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create_bite(analyst)\n    response = post_form(analyst, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/delete\", {})\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert BITE[\"title\"] in bite_row(analyst, BITE[\"slug\"])\n    # And the UI doesn't offer it.\n    assert \"/delete\" not in analyst.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text\n\n\ndef test_director_deletes_a_data_bite(client_as):\n    analyst, director = client_as(\"editor\"), client_as(\"admin\")\n    bid = create_bite(analyst)\n    response = post_form(director, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/delete\", {})\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert BITE[\"slug\"] not in director.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/delete\", {}).status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_duplicate_slug_is_rejected_with_a_validation_error(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    create_bite(analyst)\n    response = post_form(analyst, \"/admin/data-bites\",\n                         {**BITE, \"title\": \"A different title\"})\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert f\"already uses the slug {BITE['slug']}\" in response.text\n    assert \"A different title\" not in bite_row(analyst, BITE[\"slug\"])\n    assert analyst.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text.count(\"<code>fall-enrollment</code>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_any_analyst_edits_any_data_bite_and_author_and_created_at_are_kept(client_as):\n    riley = second_analyst(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    bid = create_bite(riley)\n    backdate(\"data_bites\", bid)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef existing_bite(client_as):\n    return create_bite(client_as(\"editor\"))\n\n\ndef assert_unchanged(c: TestClient):\n    \"\"\"The Data Bite from `existing_bite` is still the only one, still a draft,\n    with its original title.\"\"\"\n    listing = c.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text\n    assert listing.count('id=\"data-bite-') == 1\n    row = bite_row(c, BITE[\"slug\"])\n    assert BITE[\"title\"] in row and \"Draft\" in row\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path, data\", ROUTES)\ndef test_anonymous_visitor_is_redirected_from_every_data_bite_route(\n        client, client_as, existing_bite, method, path, data):\n    response = client.request(method, path.format(id=existing_bite),\n                              data=data or None, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code in (302, 303, 307)\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"].endswith(\"/login\")\n    assert_unchanged(client_as(\"admin\"))\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path, data\", POST_ROUTES)\ndef test_data_bite_posts_without_csrf_token_are_rejected(\n        client_as, existing_bite, path.format(id=existing_bite), data, with_csrf=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert_unchanged(director)\n\n\ndef test_every_signed_in_user_sees_the_data_bites_link(client_as):\n = {\"title\": \"Fall enrollment snapshot\", \"slug\": \"fall-enrollment\",\n        \"body\": \"Enrollment is **1,745** this fall.\"}\n\n\ndef bite_row(c: TestClient, slug: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"This Data Bite's row of the admin list, as HTML.\"\"\"\n    for row in c.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text.split(\"<tr\")[1:]:\n        if f\"<code>{slug}</code>\" in row:\n            return row\n    raise AssertionError(f\"{slug} is not listed\")\n\n\ndef bite_id(c: TestClient, slug: str) -> str:\n    return re.match(r' id=\"data-bite-(\\d+)\"', bite_row(c, slug)).group(1)\n\n\ndef create_bite(c: TestClient, **override) -> str:\n    response = post_form(c, \"/admin/data-bites\", {**BITE, **override})\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return bite_id(c, override.get(\"slug\", BITE[\"slug\"]))\n\n\ndef test_analyst_creates_a_data_bite_as_a_draft(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_form(analyst, \"/admin/data-bites\", BITE)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/data-bites\"\n\n    row = bite_row(analyst, BITE[\"slug\"])\n    assert BITE[\"title\"] in row and \"Draft\" in row\n\n\ndef test_analyst_publishes_and_unpublishes_a_data_bite(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create_bite(analyst)\n\n    response = post_form(analyst, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/publish\", {})\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"Published\" in bite_row(analyst, BITE[\"slug\"])\n\n    response = post_form(analyst, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/unpublish\", {})\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"Draft\" in bite_row(analyst, BITE[\"slug\"])\n\n\ndef test_analyst_cannot_delete_a_data_bite(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create_bite(analyst)\n    response = post_form(analyst, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/delete\", {})\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert BITE[\"title\"] in bite_row(analyst, BITE[\"slug\"])\n    # And the UI doesn't offer it.\n    assert \"/delete\" not in {"parentUuid":"d947a39c-5ca9-4335-a118-add144f3e13f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"eb019712-94ba-463b-8cf2-b3c8e4254f55","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0137WThmEho39oCdM6aJG5Lh","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role — it works as soon as your login route exists,\nso access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db, settings, users\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\"},\n}\n\n\ndef csrf_from(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', html)\n    assert match, \"no csrf_token field in the page\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef post_form(c: TestClient, path: str, data: dict, *, with_csrf=True):\n    \"\"\"POST an admin form as the logged-in client, with the session's CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    if with_csrf:\n        data = {**data, \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)}\n    return c.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef user_row(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"This user's row of the Director's {"parentUuid":"1e659e8d-2490-41f5-a212-236a3e3ed958","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"eb019712-94ba-463b-8cf2-b3c8e4254f55","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NXoTC2EeJq2KKHNbS64VnF","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The Jinja environment the admin console and the public site render with.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import NamedTuple\n\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.auth import csrf_token\nfrom app.content import SUMMARY_MAX\nfrom app.flash import confirmation\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\nfrom app.users import ROLE_LABELS, is_director\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef path_for(context, name: str, **path_params) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The path of the admin route called `name` (its function's name), e.g.\n    path_for(\"edit_report_form\", report_id=3) -> \"/admin/reports/3\", so a\n    template never hard-codes a route's path. Admin pages only: the public\n    site links relatively (app.public_site).\"\"\"\n    return str(context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **path_params))\n\n\nclass NavItem(NamedTuple):\n    label: str\n    route: str           # the admin route's name, for path_for\n    director_only: bool\n\n\n# The console's numbered nav (spec #25), in order.\nCONSOLE_NAV = (NavItem(\"Dashboard\", \"admin_home\", False), NavItem(\"Data Bites\", \"list_bites\", False),\n               NavItem(\"Reports\", \"list_reports\", False), NavItem(\"Homepage\", \"edit_homepage\", True),\n               NavItem(\"Users\", \"list_users\", True))\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef console_nav(context, user) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"`user`'s nav items, numbered as in CONSOLE_NAV, each with its path and\n    whether it is the section the page is in: the item whose path is the\n    longest prefix of the page's. A page in a section `user` may not see\n    (an Analyst's \"Not allowed\" at /admin/users) marks none.\"\"\"\n    request = context[\"request\"]\n    page = request.url.path\n    items = [(nav, {\"number\": f\"{n:02d}\", \"label\": nav.label,\n                    \"path\": str(request.app.url_path_for(nav.route))})\n             for n, nav in enumerate(CONSOLE_NAV, start=1)]\n    within = [item for _, item in items\n              if page == item[\"path\"] or page.startswith(item[\"path\"] + \"/\")]\n    here = max(within, key=lambda item: len(item[\"path\"]), default=None)\n    return [{**item, \"current\": item is here} for nav, item in items\n            if is_director(user) or not nav.director_only]\n\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\ntemplates.env.globals[\"path_for\"] = path_for\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_nav\"] = console_nav\ntemplates.env.globals[\"confirmation\"] = confirmation\ntemplates.env.globals[\"summary_max\"] = SUMMARY_MAX\ntemplates.env.filters[\"role_label\"] = ROLE_LABELS.get\ntemplates.env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite,\nand add or remove its chart images (shift continuity, ADR-003, ADR-004); only\na Director may delete one, which the routes enforce. Editing never changes the\nauthor or created_at. Deleting a Data Bite deletes its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images\nfrom app.content import ContentTable\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\", \"data-bite\")\n_IMAGES = \"data-bites\"  # the chart_images kind\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *, summary: str = \"\") -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft. It starts with no images, even if a deleted Data Bite\n    that had its id left some behind (SQLite may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, summary=summary,\n                         also=lambda conn, bite_id: chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id))\n\n\ndef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *, summary: str = \"\",\n           base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, body, and Summary. Reports, draft/publish lockdown (issue #5).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom tests.conftest import backdate, post_form, second_analyst\nfrom tests.test_t06_admin_console import preview_of\n\nREPORT = {\"title\": \"Factbook 2026\", \"slug\": \"factbook\",\n          \"body\": \"Admissions, enrollment, and **program** statistics.\"}\n\n\ndef report_row(c: TestClient, slug: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"This Report's row of the admin list, as HTML.\"\"\"\n    for row in c.get(\"/admin/reports\").text.split(\"<tr\")[1:]:\n        if f\"<code>{slug}</code>\" in row:\n            return row\n    raise AssertionError(f\"{slug} is not listed\")\n\n\ndef report_id(c: TestClient, slug: str) -> str:\n    return re.match(r' id=\"report-(\\d+)\"', report_row(c, slug)).group(1)\n\n\ndef create_report(c: TestClient, **override) -> str:\n    response = post_form(c, \"/admin/reports\", {**REPORT, **override})\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return report_id(c, override.get(\"slug\", REPORT[\"slug\"]))\n\n\ndef published_report(director: TestClient, analyst: TestClient) -> str:\n    \"\"\"An Analyst-drafted Report that the Director has published.\"\"\"\n    rid = create_report(analyst)\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n    return rid\n\n\ndef test_analyst_creates_a_draft_report(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_form(analyst, \"/admin/reports\", REPORT)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/reports\"\n    row = report_row(analyst, REPORT[\"slug\"])\n    assert REPORT[\"title\"] in row and \"Draft\" in row\n\n\ndef test_a_report_requires_a_markdown_body(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_form(analyst, \"/admin/reports\", {**REPORT, \"body\": \"   \"})\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"Enter a body.\" in response.text\n    assert f\"<code>{REPORT['slug']}</code>\" not in analyst.get(\"/admin/reports\").text\n\n\ndef test_any_analyst_edits_any_draft_report_and_author_and_created_at_are_kept(client_as):\n    riley = second_analyst(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    rid = create_report(riley)\ndef mixed_content(director: TestClient, analyst: TestClient) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Two Data Bites and two Reports, one of each published.\"\"\"\n    create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"bite-draft\")\n    publish(analyst, \"data-bites\", create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"bite-live\"))\n    create(analyst, \"reports\", \"report-draft\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(analyst, \"reports\", \"report-live\"))\n\n\ndef test_content_list_shows_both_types_newest_first(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    mixed_content(director, analyst)\n    with db.connect() as conn:  # setup: make \"bite-draft\" the most recently updated\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE data_bites SET updated_at = '2999-01-01 00:00:00'\"\n                     \" WHERE slug = 'bite-draft'\")\n\n    rows = listed(analyst)\n    assert rows[0] == (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Draft\", \"Draft\")\n    assert sorted(rows) == [\n        (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Draft\", \"Draft\"), (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Live\", \"Published\"),\n        (\"Report\", \"Report-Draft\", \"Draft\"), (\"Report\", \"Report-Live\", \"Published\"),\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_content_list_filters_by_type(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    mixed_content(director, analyst)\n    assert {r[:2] for r in listed(analyst, \"?type=report\")} == {\n        (\"Report\", \"Report-Draft\"), (\"Report\", \"Report-Live\")}\n    assert {r[:2] for r in listed(analyst, \"?type=data-bite\")} == {\n        (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Draft\"), (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Live\")}\n\n\ndef test_content_list_filters_by_status(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    mixed_content(director, analyst)\n    assert sorted(listed(analyst, \"?status=draft\")) == [\n        (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Draft\", \"Draft\"), (\"Report\", \"Report-Draft\", \"Draft\")]\n    assert sorted(listed(analyst, \"?status=published\")) == [\n        (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Live\", \"Published\"), (\"Report\", \"Report-Live\", \"Published\")]\n\n\ndef test_content_list_filters_combine(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    mixed_content(director, analyst)\n    assert listed(director, \"?type=report&status=published\") == [\n        (\"Report\", \"Report-Live\", \"Published\")]\n    # The filter form's \"All\" options submit empty values.\n    assert len(listed(director, \"?type=&status=\")) == 4\n\n\ndef test_content_list_links_each_item_to_its_edit_page(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    rid = create(analyst, \"reports\", \"factbook\")\n    page = analyst.get(\"/admin/content\").text\n    assert f'<a href=\"/admin/reports/{rid}\">Factbook</a>' in page\n\n\ndef test_content_list_keeps_the_chosen_filters_selected(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/content?type=report&status=draft\").text\n    assert re.search(r'<option value=\"report\" selected>', page)\n    assert re.search(r'<option value=\"draft\" selected>', page)\n\n\ndef test_content_list_says_when_nothing_matches(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"only-a-draft\")\n    page = analyst.get(\"/admin/content?status=published\").text\n    assert \"Nothing matches\" in page and \"content-row\" not in page\n\n\ndef test_content_list_rejects_an_unknown_filter_value(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    assert analyst.get(\"/admin/content?type=page\").status_code == 422\n    assert analyst.get(\"/admin/content?status=live\").status_code == 422\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_link_to_the_filtered_list(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert 'href=\"/admin/content?type=report&amp;status=draft\"' in page\n\n\n    shown = preview_of(analyst.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text)\n    assert \"<p>Enrollment by <em>class year</em>.</p>\" in shown\n\n\ndef test_the_new_item_forms_have_a_preview_too(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    for path in (\"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/reports\"):\n        assert preview_of(analyst.get(path).text).strip() == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_the_preview_follows_the_text_as_it_is_typed(client_as):\n    response = preview(client_as(\"editor\"), \"Draft *two*\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert body_of(response.text).strip() == \"<p>Draft <em>two</em></p>\"\n    # Nothing was saved: previewing is not creating.\n    assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/content\").text.count(\"content-row\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_a_failed_save_previews_what_was_typed(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_form(analyst, \"/admin/data-bites\",\n                         {\"title\": \"\", \"slug\": \"x\", \"body\": \"Unsaved *work*\"})\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert {"parentUuid":"db968e9d-9a8e-4fba-bee0-28143b4007c6","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfc6kB8F8v7dWY1h8g3Cg","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_016Wmb2xuMvwAKKbzQEZwtqQ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t22_lists.py","content":"\"\"\"T22: Lists and create pages (issue #27, spec #25).\n\nThe Data Bites, Reports, and All content lists are one `table-items` table:\neach item's title with its Summary, a state badge, its author, when it was\nlast updated (ISO), and the actions the user may take. The two type lists\nfilter by state with `?status=`. Creating an item has its own page, and a\ncreate lands on the new item's edit page.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT\n\nLISTS = {\"data-bites\": (\"data-bite\", BITE), \"reports\": (\"report\", REPORT)}\n\n\ndef create(c: TestClient, kind: str, slug: str, **fields) -> str:\n    _, item = LISTS[kind]\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/{kind}\", {**item, \"slug\": slug, \"title\": slug.title(),\n                                               **fields})\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return response.headers[\"location\"].rsplit(\"/\", 1)[1]\n\n\ndef published_and_draft(kind: str, director: TestClient) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    live, draft = create(director, kind, \"live\"), create(director, kind, \"draft\")\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{live}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n    return live, draft\n\n\ndef row_ids(html: str, key: str) -> list[str]:\n    return re.findall(rf'<tr id=\"{key}-(\\d+)\"', html)\n\n\ndef row(html: str, key: str, item_id: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<tr id=\"{key}-{item_id}\">(.*?)</tr>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"{key}-{item_id} is not listed\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef filters(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, bool]]:\n    \"\"\"The filter links as (href, label, count, current).\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'<nav class=\"filters-console\" aria-label=\"Filter by state\">(.*?)</nav>',\n                      html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no state filters\"\n    return [(href, label, count, bool(current)) for href, current, label, count in re.findall(\n        r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"( aria-current=\"page\")?>([^<]+)<span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d+)</span></a>',\n        match.group(1))]\n\n\n# --- The table ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_each_row_has_the_title_summary_state_author_and_iso_date(client_as, kind):\n    key, _ = LISTS[kind]\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director, kind, \"fall\", summary=\"Headcount on the census date.\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:  # setup: a known update time\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {kind.replace('-', '_')} SET updated_at = '2026-09-30 14:05:00'\")\n\n    cells = row(director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text, key, item_id)\n    assert (f'<th scope=\"row\" class=\"table-items-title\"><a href=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\">Fall</a>'\n            '<p>Headcount on the census date.</p></th>') in cells\n    assert '<span class=\"badge-state badge-state-draft\">Draft</span>' in cells\n    assert \"<td>Director</td>\" in cells or \"Admin\" in cells or \"<td>\" in cells\n    assert ('<td class=\"text-mono\"><time datetime=\"2026-09-30T14:05:00\">2026-09-30</time></td>'\n            in cells)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_a_row_without_a_summary_shows_nothing_in_its_place(client_as, kind):\n    key, _ = LISTS[kind]\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director, kind, \"fall\")\n    cells = row(director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text, key, item_id)\n    assert f'<a href=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\">Fall</a></th>' in cells\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_a_published_row_has_the_published_badge(client_as, kind):\n    key, _ = LISTS[kind]\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    live, _ = published_and_draft(kind, director)\n    cells = row(director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text, key, live)\n    assert '<span class=\"badge-state badge-state-published\">Published</span>' in cells\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_the_directors_row_actions_are_edit_unpublish_or_publish_and_delete(client_as, kind):\n    key, _ = LISTS[kind]\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    live, draft = published_and_draft(kind, director)\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text\n    for item_id, action in ((live, \"unpublish\"), (draft, \"publish\")):\n        cells = row(page, key, item_id)\n        assert f'<a class=\"button-quiet\" href=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\">Edit</a>' in cells\n        form = re.search(rf'<form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/{action}\">(.*?)</form>',\n                         cells, re.S)\n        assert form and 'name=\"csrf_token\"' in form.group(1), action\n        assert f'href=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/delete\"' in cells\n\n\ndef test_an_analyst_publishes_data_bites_but_deletes_nothing(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"fall\")\n    cells = row(analyst.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text, \"data-bite\", bid)\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/publish\"' in cells\n    assert \"/delete\" not in cells\n\n\ndef test_an_analyst_may_not_publish_a_report_and_views_a_published_one(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    live, draft = published_and_draft(\"reports\", director)\n    page = analyst.get(\"/admin/reports\").text\n    assert \"/publish\" not in page and \"/unpublish\" not in page and \"/delete\" not in page\n    # A published Report is locked for an Analyst: its page is read-only.\n    assert f'<a class=\"button-quiet\" href=\"/admin/reports/{draft}\">Edit</a>' in row(page, \"report\", draft)\n    assert f'<a class=\"button-quiet\" href=\"/admin/reports/{live}\">View</a>' in row(page, \"report\", live)\n\n\n# --- Filters -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_each_filter_shows_only_its_state(client_as, kind):\n    key, _ = LISTS[kind]\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    live, draft = published_and_draft(kind, director)\n\n    def listed(query: str) -> set[str]:\n        response = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}{query}\")\n        assert response.status_code == 200\n        return set(row_ids(response.text, key))\n\n    assert listed(\"\") == listed(\"?status=\") == {live, draft}\n    assert listed(\"?status=published\") == {live}\n    assert listed(\"?status=draft\") == {draft}\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_the_filters_show_their_counts_and_mark_the_current_one(client_as, kind):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    published_and_draft(kind, director)\n    create(director, kind, \"another-draft\")\n    assert filters(director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}?status=draft\").text) == [\n        (f\"/admin/{kind}\", \"All\", \"3\", False),\n        (f\"/admin/{kind}?status=published\", \"Published\", \"1\", False),\n        (f\"/admin/{kind}?status=draft\", \"Drafts\", \"2\", True),\n    ]\n    assert [current for *_, current in filters(director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text)] == [\n        True, False, False]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/reports\", \"/admin/content\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status\", [\"live\", \"Draft\", \"pending\"])\ndef test_an_unknown_status_is_a_400(client_as, path, status):\n    assert client_as(\"editor\").get(f\"{path}?status={status}\").status_code == 400\n\n\ndef test_an_unknown_type_on_all_content_is_a_400(client_as):\n    assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/content?type=page\").status_code == 400\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_an_empty_filter_says_so(client_as, kind):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    create(director, kind, \"only-a-draft\")\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}?status=published\").text\n    assert \"Nothing is Published yet.\" in page and \"<tbody>\" not in page\n\n\n# --- Create pages ------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_the_list_no_longer_holds_the_create_form(client_as, kind):\n    page = client_as(\"editor\").get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text\n    assert 'name=\"title\"' not in page and \"admin-editor\" not in page\n    noun = \"Data Bite\" if kind == \"data-bites\" else \"Report\"\n    assert f'<a class=\"button-primary\" href=\"/admin/{kind}/new\">New {noun}</a>' in page\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_the_new_page_renders_the_create_form(client_as, kind):\n    response = client_as(\"editor\").get(f\"/admin/{kind}/new\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    page = response.text\n    form = re.search(rf'<form class=\"admin-content-editing\" method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/{kind}\"'\n                     r'[^>]*>(.*?)</form>', page, re.S)\n    assert form, \"no create form posting to the list\"\n    for name in (\"csrf_token\", \"title\", \"summary\", \"slug\", \"body\"):\n        assert Lists and create pages (issue #27, spec #25).\n\nThe Data Bites, Reports, and All content lists are one `table-items` table:\neach item's title with its Summary, a state badge, its author, when it was\nlast updated (ISO), and the actions the user may take. The two type lists\nfilter by state with `?status=`. Creating an item has its own page, and a\ncreate lands on the new item's edit page.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT\n\nLISTS = {\"data-bites\": (\"data-bite\", BITE), \"reports\": (\"report\", REPORT)}\n\n\ndef create(c: TestClient, kind: str, slug: str, **fields) -> str:\n    _, item = LISTS[kind]\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/{kind}\", {**item, \"slug\": slug, \"title\": slug.title(),\n                                               **fields})\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return response.headers[\"location\"].rsplit(\"/\", 1)[1]\n\n\ndef published_and_draft(kind: str, director: TestClient) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    live, draft = create(director, kind, \"live\"), create(director, kind, \"draft\")\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{live}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n    return live, draft\n\n\ndef row_ids(html: str, key: str) -> list[str]:\n    return re.findall(rf'<tr id=\"{key}-(\\d+)\"', html)\n\n\ndef row(html: str, key: str, item_id: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<tr id=\"{key}-{item_id}\">(.*?)</tr>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"{key}-{item_id} is not listed\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef filters(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, bool]]:\n    \"\"\"The filter links as (href, label, count, current).\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'<nav class=\"filters-console\" aria-label=\"Filter by state\">(.*?)</nav>',\n                      html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no state filters\"\n    return [(href, label, count, bool(current)) for href, current, label, count in re.findall(\n        r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"( aria-current=\"page\")?>([^<]+)<span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d+)</span></a>',\n        match.group(1))]\n\n\n# --- The table ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_each_row_has_the_title_summary_state_author_and_iso_date(client_as, kind):\n    key, _ = LISTS[kind]\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director, kind, \"fall\", summary=\"Headcount on the census date.\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:  # setup: a known update time\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {kind.replace('-', '_')} SET updated_at = '2026-09-30 14:05:00'\")\n\n    cells = row(director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text, key, item_id)\n    assert (f'<th scope=\"row\" class=\"table-items-title\"><a href=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\">Fall</a>'\n            '<p>Headcount on the census date.</p></th>') in cells\n    assert '<span class=\"badge-state badge-state-draft\">Draft</span>' in cells\n    assert \"<td>Director</td>\" in cells or \"Admin\" in cells or \"<td>\" in cells\n    assert ('<td class=\"text-mono\"><time datetime=\"2026-09-30T14:05:00\">2026-09-30</time></td>'\n            in cells)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_a_row_without_a_summary_shows_nothing_in_its_place(client_as, kind):\n    key, _ = LISTS[kind]\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director, kind, \"fall\")\n    cells = row(director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text, key, item_id)\n    assert f'<a href=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\">Fall</a></th>' in cells\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_a_published_row_has_the_published_badge(client_as, kind):\n    key, _ = LISTS[kind]\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    live, _ = published_and_draft(kind, director)\n    cells = row(director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text, key, live)\n    assert '<span class=\"badge-state badge-state-published\">Published</span>' in cells\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef test_the_directors_row_actions_are_edit_unpublish_or_publish_and_delete(client_as, kind):\n    key, _ = LISTS[kind]\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    live, draft = published_and_draft(kind, director)\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text\n    for item_id, action in ((live, \"unpublish\"), (draft, \"publish\")):\n        cells = row(page, key, item_id)\n        assert f'<a class=\"button-quiet\" href=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\">Edit</a>' in cells\n        form = re.search(rf'<form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/{action}\">(.*?)</form>',\n test_an_analyst_publishes_data_bites_but_deletes_nothing(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"fall\")\n    cells = row(analyst.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text, \"data-bite\", bid)\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/publish\"' in cells\n    assert \"/delete\" not in cells\n\n\ndef test_an_analyst_may_not_publish_a_report_and_views_a_published_one(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    live, draft = published_and_draft(\"reports\",
